# AmazingPlugins - Full Site Index

## Site Overview
AmazingPlugins is a WooCommerce accessibility tool company. We provide free plugins and educational content to help store owners achieve WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.

## Main Plugin
### WooCommerce Accessibility Fixer
- **Price:** Free
- **Platform:** WordPress/WooCommerce
- **URL:** https://wordpress.org/plugins/amazingplugins-accessibility-fixer-for-woocommerce/
- **Current version:** See the WordPress.org listing.

**Features:**
1. Alt Text Fixer - Adds missing alt text to product images
2. Keyboard Navigation - Ensures keyboard accessibility
3. Focus Indicator Fix - Adds visible focus states
4. ARIA Labels - Adds proper ARIA attributes
5. Color Contrast - Fixes contrast ratio issues
6. Form Labels - Adds missing form labels
7. Heading Hierarchy - Fixes heading structure
8. Skip Links - Adds skip navigation
9. Landmark Regions - Adds ARIA landmarks
10. Error Messages - Improves error messaging
